statement: This visualization depicts a fluid, tidal landscape composed of horizontal color bands that move in harmony with a slow sine wave rhythm. Each band represents a layer of water at different depths, shifting smoothly to mimic the ebb and flow of tides. A distinctive dark band marks the current high-water level, creating a visual anchor within the continuous motion. The entire composition breathes naturally without any external input, offering a meditative representation of fluid dynamics through pure color and movement.
